caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden ornament featuring a large, detailed eagle with its wings spread wide. The eagle, colored in muted tones of tan and brown with darker shading, occupies the central portion of the image. It has a slightly downturned head with a yellow beak and visible red on the inside of its mouth. Beneath the eagle, the carving extends into two large blue-green acanthus leaves, one on each side, with intricate veins and shapes. Each leaf surrounds a circular aperture or ring with a shaded interior, positioned symmetrically to the left and right beneath the eagle’s wings. A pair of red-brown scroll patterns extend outward and upward from beneath each circular ring, curling around the base of the acanthus leaves. The background is a plain, beige parchment-like surface, and below the ornament, the name “Elmer G. Anderson” is written in spaced-out capitalized letters.
title: Hoseholder with Fire Company Insignia
